# Motor City Math  test grading and curriculum tools

This repo is a spoke in the Forge hub+spoke architecture.

## Agent Identity & Protocol
- **Agent roster:** See `forge/AGENTS.md` for your identity and all agent roles
- **Behavioral rules:** See `forge/.agent-protocol.md`
- **Your specialization:** See `forge/knowledge/agents/{YOUR_ID}.md`
- **Your skills:** See `forge/skills/{YOUR_ID}/_index.md`
- **Lessons log:** Check `forge/LESSONS.md` before planning any action
- **Project context:** See `forge/knowledge/projects/mcm.md`

## Work Tracking
- Find your work: `gh issue list --label agent:{YOUR_ID}`
- Use cross-session messaging for real-time coordination with other agents

## Key Rule
The forge/ repository is the single source of truth for agent identity, protocol, skills, and shared knowledge.
This repo contains only product code and project-specific configuration.
